title: People Ops - Recruiting Coordinator Daily Scratchpad (2026-03-16)
content:
Morning run-through (quick)
- coffee, check calendar, triage inbox (30m)
- urgent first: candidate follow-ups + reschedules

Top-of-day TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm interviews for 3:30pm PT (Lara M.) - still showing tentative from hiring manager (Diego). If no confirmation by 10:30am PT, send reminder + offer alternate times.
- [ ] Send follow-up to Candidate A (GREENHOUSE:candidate-98765) re: take-home assignment deadline extension (requested yesterday). Action: give until Mon 3/22, confirm updated link.
- [ ] Reschedule phone screen w/ Candidate B - interviewer canceled (Priya) - propose Tue 3/17 11am PT / Wed 3/18 9am PT. Include zoom link and prep doc.
- [ ] Quick check: Candidate C (onsite loop) - ensure panel notes template attached to calendar invite.
- [ ] Process offer packet draft for Candidate D (SWE IC) - need hiring manager comp approval (sent email 3/15). Chase if no response by EOD.

Interview logistics / calendar notes:
- Block for panel interviews 1:00-4:00pm PT today - double-check interviewer availability; two overlapping interviews may need swapping.
- Time zones: Candidate E in CET (Germany). Offer times suggested Fri 9am-12pm CET (works out to Thu evening PT). Add clear timezone in invites.
- Rooms: Reserve conf-room B for in-person loop next Tues (work with facilities).

Candidate follow-ups (quick snippets):
- Candidate F - asked about remote/hybrid policy. Reply: link to handbook + line about team's current expectation (hybrid 3x/wk). Draft done, send after review.
- Candidate G - waiting on coding exercise feedback from Eng team. Pinged eng-reviewers Slack @eng-hiring (thread ID in linked_artifacts).
- Candidate H - declined, send courteous close note and ask for permission to keep resume on file.

Notes to self / process improvements:
- Add template to GH for "interviewer no-show" follow-up email (standardize wording).
- Create checklist for panel prep: calendar invite, panelist intro blurb, score rubric link, travel directions (if onsite).
- Ask Recruiting Lead (Diego) about automating reminder 24h before interviews for panel leads.

Unresolved / questions:
- Do we have an updated list of backup interviewers for Eng (in case of last-minute cancel)? (Priya to confirm)
- Offer comp band for Sr PM needs verification - who signs off? (email sent to hiring manager + finance).

End-of-day wrap:
- [ ] Update GH statuses: moved 2 candidates to "Onsite"; 1 to "Offer"; 3 follow-ups outstanding.
- [ ] Log time spent on scheduling + candidate comms (for weekly report).
- Quick wins for tomorrow: bulk-send reminders for 24h interview confirmations; finalize offer letter template text.

Misc quick notes (scratch):
- Slack: ping #recruiting for interviewer coverage during 3pm slot.
- Templates to update: travel reimbursement, interview feedback rubric (add TLDR).
- Personal: bring printed copies of interview rubrics for onsite panels.

---
Raw snippets of candidate replies / copy
- "Thanks for the update - Tue works best for me. Could we do 11am PT?" (Candidate B)
- "Appreciate the extension, will submit by Mon." (Candidate A)

End of scratchpad for 2026-03-16.
